blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ بَعَثَ إِلي بَنِي لِحْيَانَ فَقَالَ: لِيَخْرُجْ مِنْ كُلَِّ رَجُلَيْنِ رَجُلٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلْقَاعِدِ: أَيُّكُمْ خَلَفَ الْخَارِجَ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ بِخَيْرٍ، كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ نِصْفِ أَجْرِ الْخَارِجِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب فضل اعانة الغازي في سبيل الله، رقم: ٤٩٠٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates, “Rasulullah ﷺ sent word to the tribe of Banu Lihyan that one man out of every two men should go out in the path of Allah. Then he said to those who stayed behind in the town, “Whoever among you looks after (protects) well the family and the possessions of the one who has gone out in the path of Allah while he is away, he will receive half the reward of the one who went out in the path of Allah.””

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ نِ الْجُهَنِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ جَهَّزَ حَاجّاً، أَوْ جَهَّزَ غَازِياً، أَوْ خَلَفَهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ، أَوْ فَطَّرَ صَائِماً، فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَنْقُصَ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ شَيْئاً.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Zaid ibn Khalid al-Juhani (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever makes the travel arrangements of one going for Hajj, or of one going out in the path of Allah Ta'ala, or is a help and support in the affairs of his family after he has gone, or helps a fasting person to break his fast, he too will receive a reward equal to that of the one who went in the path of Allah Ta'ala, or the one who set out for Hajj, or the one who fasted. And there will be no decrease at all in their reward.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ جَهَّزَ غَازِياً فِي
